# airlock_blocklist_metarule (Resource)

Manage an Airlock blocklist metarule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "airlock_blocklist_metarule" "example" {
  package_id = "1700000001"
  name       = "tf-example-block-metarule"
  os         = "windows"

  criteria_json = jsonencode([
    {
      field     = "path"
      operation = "wildcard"
      value     = "C:\\Temp\\*"
    }
  ])

  settings_json = jsonencode({
    notification      = 1
    notification_text = ""
    upload            = 1
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `criteria_json` (String) JSON array of 1-5 Airlock metarule criteria objects.
- `name` (String) Metarule name.
- `os` (String) Operating system: windows, linux, or mac.
- `package_id` (String) Target Airlock package ID.

### Optional

- `settings_json` (String) Optional JSON object of Airlock metarule settings.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Airlock metarule UUID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import airlock_blocklist_metarule.example 1700000001:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
